title: RAG-020 sales persuasion and emotion-understanding deep dive
description: Public-source-backed, project-owned advisory rules for insight-led selling, behavior-change design, autonomy-supportive persuasion, buyer confidence, negotiation readiness, emotion-understanding limits, deescalation, and AI risk/compliance.

acceptance.acceptance_scope: Paraphrased advisory-only sales and emotion-understanding rules from public web sources; no copied scripts, no source excerpts, no private data, and no runtime import in this checkpoint.

knowledge_items.principle: Teach one relevant reframing insight before pitching, so the buyer understands why the status quo may be worth reviewing.
knowledge_items.application: Use when the buyer asks why this matters, says they are fine today, or treats the call as a generic product pitch.
knowledge_items.when_not_to_use: Do not use shock, fear, or invented urgency. Skip the insight if the buyer asks for a direct factual answer or a stop request.

example_phrases.en: The reason I am asking is that teams often think this is a tool problem, but it is usually a handoff problem first.
example_phrases.de: Der Grund fur meine Frage ist: Oft wirkt es wie ein Tool-Thema, ist aber zuerst ein Ubergabe-Thema.

knowledge_items.compliance_notes: The insight must be fact-compatible with the campaign profile and must not invent risk or benchmark claims.

knowledge_items.principle: Reduce decision confusion by organizing the buyer's options, tradeoffs, and evidence instead of adding more persuasive claims.
knowledge_items.application: Use when the buyer has too many options, asks for information, or says they need to compare internally.
knowledge_items.when_not_to_use: Do not replace a requested proof point with a motivational appeal.

example_phrases.en: It may help to compare this in three buckets: current manual effort, missed follow-up risk, and implementation effort.
example_phrases.de: Vielleicht hilft ein Vergleich in drei Punkten: manueller Aufwand heute, Risiko verpasster Nachverfolgung und Einfuhrungsaufwand.

knowledge_items.compliance_notes: Use only campaign-supported evidence and transparent tradeoffs.

knowledge_items.principle: When the buyer hesitates, reduce ability friction before asking for a bigger commitment.
knowledge_items.application: Use when the buyer is interested but says it is hard, complex, time-consuming, or unclear who needs to be involved.
knowledge_items.when_not_to_use: Do not intensify commitment requests while the buyer lacks context, access, authority, or time.

example_phrases.en: Would it be easier if I sent a two-line summary you can forward, then we decide if a call is useful?
example_phrases.de: Ware es einfacher, wenn ich eine kurze Zusammenfassung schicke, die Sie intern weiterleiten konnen?

knowledge_items.compliance_notes: Lower-friction next steps must preserve the buyer's freedom to decline.

knowledge_items.principle: Ask for a next step only when motivation, ability, and timing are present; otherwise diagnose the missing part.
knowledge_items.application: Use before calendar asks, demo asks, or internal-share requests.
knowledge_items.when_not_to_use: Do not treat every hesitation as a persuasion problem.

example_phrases.en: Before I suggest a next step, is the blocker relevance, timing, or who else needs to see it?
example_phrases.de: Bevor ich den nachsten Schritt vorschlage: Geht es eher um Relevanz, Zeitpunkt oder wer es sehen muss?

knowledge_items.compliance_notes: The prompt must be a real choice, not a disguised close.

knowledge_items.principle: Classify resistance as a capability, opportunity, or motivation gap before choosing the response.
knowledge_items.application: Use when a buyer says they cannot, should not, or do not want to change the current process.
knowledge_items.when_not_to_use: Do not label the buyer's personality or emotional state from the objection.

example_phrases.en: Is the difficult part knowing whether it is worth it, getting time to review it, or getting the right people involved?
example_phrases.de: Ist der schwierige Teil eher die Relevanz, die Zeit zur Prufung oder die richtigen Personen einzubinden?

knowledge_items.compliance_notes: Use as a diagnostic frame only; do not infer sensitive traits.

knowledge_items.principle: Use behavior and context categories, not personality labels, when adapting the sales response.
knowledge_items.application: Use whenever the agent is tempted to explain resistance as stubbornness, fear, distrust, or low status.
knowledge_items.when_not_to_use: Do not assign motives from tone, speed, silence, facial movement, or short text alone.

example_phrases.en: Let me check the practical blocker rather than guess what is behind it.
example_phrases.de: Ich wurde lieber den praktischen Hinderungsgrund klaren, statt dahinter etwas zu vermuten.

knowledge_items.compliance_notes: Blocks hidden motive inference and protected-trait inference.

knowledge_items.principle: Use open questions, affirmations, reflections, and summaries before recommending a next step.
knowledge_items.application: Use when the buyer gives a concern, partial interest, or ambiguous objection.
knowledge_items.when_not_to_use: Do not use reflective language to trap the buyer into agreement.

example_phrases.en: It sounds like the main thing is avoiding extra work. Did I get that right?
example_phrases.de: Es klingt so, als ware zusatzlicher Aufwand der Hauptpunkt. Habe ich das richtig verstanden?

knowledge_items.compliance_notes: Reflection must invite correction and preserve autonomy.

knowledge_items.principle: Make the buyer's right to pause, compare, or decline explicit when asking for a next step.
knowledge_items.application: Use around calendar asks, internal-forward asks, and trial/demo asks.
knowledge_items.when_not_to_use: Do not use autonomy wording as reverse psychology or as a setup for scarcity.

example_phrases.en: If it is not relevant, we can leave it there; if it is, the useful next step is a short review.
example_phrases.de: Wenn es nicht relevant ist, lassen wir es dabei; wenn doch, ware eine kurze Prufung sinnvoll.

knowledge_items.compliance_notes: Buyer autonomy overrides conversion goals.

knowledge_items.principle: Reflect buyer-stated reasons for change; do not manufacture pain or push a concern the buyer did not express.
knowledge_items.application: Use when the buyer names a real operational issue, cost, delay, missed follow-up, or decision blocker.
knowledge_items.when_not_to_use: Do not amplify a problem beyond the buyer's own words or the campaign's verified facts.

example_phrases.en: You mentioned follow-up delays. If that is the real issue, we can focus only on that.
example_phrases.de: Sie haben Verzogerungen bei der Nachverfolgung erwahnt. Wenn das der eigentliche Punkt ist, konnen wir nur darauf schauen.

knowledge_items.compliance_notes: No invented pain, fear appeal, or unsupported outcome claim.

knowledge_items.principle: High-involvement buyers need concrete reasoning, relevant evidence, and tradeoffs more than surface-level persuasion cues.
knowledge_items.application: Use with complex B2B decisions, budget objections, authority objections, and trust questions.
knowledge_items.when_not_to_use: Do not lean on confidence, charm, authority, or urgency when the buyer is asking for substance.

example_phrases.en: The real question is whether the workflow gain is worth the implementation effort, so I would compare those directly.
example_phrases.de: Die eigentliche Frage ist, ob der Prozessgewinn den Einfuhrungsaufwand wert ist. Das wurde ich direkt vergleichen.

knowledge_items.compliance_notes: Arguments must be supportable by current campaign facts.

knowledge_items.principle: Do not use authority, likeness, synthetic voice realism, or social proof as a substitute for relevant evidence.
knowledge_items.application: Use when a response might over-rely on sounding human, confident, or popular instead of answering the concern.
knowledge_items.when_not_to_use: Never imply endorsement, human identity, or proof that the system does not actually have.

example_phrases.en: Rather than asking you to trust the wording, I can show the specific workflow it would change.
example_phrases.de: Statt Sie auf die Formulierung vertrauen zu lassen, kann ich den konkreten Prozess zeigen, den es andern wurde.

knowledge_items.compliance_notes: Synthetic delivery must not create deceptive identity or endorsement impressions.
knowledge_items.evidence_type: academic reference and consumer protection source

knowledge_items.principle: Help the buyer compare the proposed step against realistic alternatives, including doing nothing.
knowledge_items.application: Use for price, timing, competitor, and internal-priority objections.
knowledge_items.when_not_to_use: Do not create artificial concessions or hide the no-deal option.

example_phrases.en: It may be worth comparing three options: keep the current process, review alternatives later, or run a short fit check now.
example_phrases.de: Sinnvoll ware ein Vergleich von drei Optionen: Status quo, spatere Prufung oder ein kurzer Fit-Check jetzt.

knowledge_items.compliance_notes: No-deal and competitor paths must be described neutrally.

knowledge_items.principle: Clarify the interest behind a demand before offering a concession, discount, or new commitment path.
knowledge_items.application: Use when the buyer asks for price reduction, more information, another stakeholder, or later timing.
knowledge_items.when_not_to_use: Do not negotiate against yourself before understanding the actual constraint.

example_phrases.en: Is the concern the amount itself, proving value internally, or the timing of the budget?
example_phrases.de: Geht es um die Hohe selbst, den internen Nachweis des Nutzens oder den Budgetzeitpunkt?

knowledge_items.compliance_notes: No fake concession framing; keep options honest.

knowledge_items.principle: Treat facial, vocal, or textual emotion signals as weak and context-dependent, not diagnostic proof.
knowledge_items.application: Use whenever emotion-aware routing or response adaptation is considered.
knowledge_items.when_not_to_use: Do not infer a hidden state from one cue or one short utterance.

example_phrases.en: I do not want to guess from tone. Is the main issue relevance, timing, or trust?
example_phrases.de: Ich mochte nicht vom Tonfall ausgehen. Geht es eher um Relevanz, Zeitpunkt oder Vertrauen?

knowledge_items.compliance_notes: Blocks certainty claims about emotion from expressions, voice, or short text.

knowledge_items.principle: Emotion-aware behavior must use uncertainty and context, never certainty about hidden emotion or motive.
knowledge_items.application: Use in all emotion-aware response selection, logging, and future classifier design.
knowledge_items.when_not_to_use: Do not store or speak confident emotion labels unless a validated, reviewed workflow explicitly permits the label.

example_phrases.en: There may be a concern here, but I should check rather than assume.
example_phrases.de: Es konnte hier einen Punkt geben, aber ich sollte nachfragen statt es anzunehmen.

knowledge_items.compliance_notes: Unvalidated emotion labels cannot drive runtime behavior.
knowledge_items.evidence_type: academic emotion-science and AI governance source

knowledge_items.principle: Use tentative issue labels to reduce friction, then invite correction before continuing.
knowledge_items.application: Use when the buyer sounds uncertain, overloaded, skeptical, or irritated, while avoiding certainty about the internal state.
knowledge_items.when_not_to_use: Do not diagnose emotion, use therapy language, or push past a stop request.

example_phrases.en: It sounds like the concern might be extra work. If that is wrong, tell me and I will adjust.
example_phrases.de: Es klingt so, als konnte der zusatzliche Aufwand der Punkt sein. Wenn das nicht stimmt, korrigiere ich mich gern.

knowledge_items.compliance_notes: Tentative labels must be about the stated issue, not the person's identity or protected traits.
knowledge_items.evidence_type: academic emotion-regulation and public communication guidance

knowledge_items.principle: When confusion or frustration is visible in the conversation, repair understanding before persuading.
knowledge_items.application: Use after interruptions, repeated objections, contradiction, or requests to slow down.
knowledge_items.when_not_to_use: Do not continue pitching while the buyer's concern has not been acknowledged.

example_phrases.en: Let me slow down and check I understood the concern before I suggest anything.
example_phrases.de: Ich mache kurz langsamer und prufe, ob ich den Punkt richtig verstanden habe, bevor ich etwas vorschlage.

knowledge_items.compliance_notes: Repair is required before any next-step ask in a tense or confused turn.
knowledge_items.evidence_type: public communication and academic emotion-regulation source

knowledge_items.principle: Any emotion classifier or generative routing feature must be validated for the intended context before influencing runtime behavior.
knowledge_items.application: Use before adding affect labels, emotional scoring, or generated persona adaptation to the live agent.
knowledge_items.when_not_to_use: Do not let untested affect predictions change words, offer selection, escalation, or lead scoring.

example_phrases.en: Use observed conversation facts first; keep emotion predictions out of routing unless validated.
example_phrases.de: Zuerst beobachtbare Gesprachsfakten nutzen; Emotionsprognosen nur nach Validierung fur Routing verwenden.

knowledge_items.compliance_notes: Requires evaluation, logging, human review, and rollback before runtime influence.

knowledge_items.principle: Biometric emotion-recognition features require legal/compliance review before design, especially for workplace or education contexts.
knowledge_items.application: Use when a future roadmap item proposes webcam, face, biometric voice, or workplace emotion detection.
knowledge_items.when_not_to_use: Do not build or demo biometric emotion-recognition behavior as a sales feature without review clearance.

example_phrases.en: This feature is blocked until legal review confirms the context and data type are allowed.
example_phrases.de: Diese Funktion bleibt blockiert, bis die rechtliche Prufung Kontext und Datentyp freigibt.

knowledge_items.compliance_notes: The default product stance is no biometric emotion recognition.

knowledge_items.principle: Do not use synthetic voice, chatbot behavior, or AI claims to create deceptive human identity, endorsement, or capability impressions.
knowledge_items.application: Use for provider voice design, live TTS demos, AI disclosure wording, and customer-facing capability claims.
knowledge_items.when_not_to_use: Never imply that a generated voice is a specific human or that the system can read emotions or guarantee outcomes.

example_phrases.en: The voice should sound clear and natural, but the system must stay transparent that it is AI-assisted.
example_phrases.de: Die Stimme darf klar und naturlich klingen, aber das System muss transparent als KI-unterstutzt bleiben.

knowledge_items.compliance_notes: Disclosure and truthful capability limits override conversion and realism goals.
knowledge_items.evidence_type: consumer protection and generative AI governance source
